messages:
carla_csm: Quick heads-up — SaffronAI (pilot) asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for an EU customer demo next Wed 10:00-12:00 UTC. Renewal chatter: this demo is high-leverage for their Q2 renewal so we want it smooth. They gave a CIDR: 35.198.12.0/24 and said expected peak is ~180 req/s during demo window.
ryan_eng: noted. Are those 180 req/s single-token calls or typical gen requests? also which model are they hitting?
carla_csm: they're using text-gen (redwood-open-7b) w/ ~60 tokens avg per request. customer account id saffron-31.
marta_infra: 180 rps with 60 tokens ~= 10.8k tps estimate (tokens/sec). We can route to europe-west3 but need to check DG/GPU headroom. quick ask: is this steady for 2 hours or bursts?
carla_csm: mostly steady with a few 400rps spikes for 30s. overall we should plan for spike capacity.
nate_prodops: we can do a temporary rate window. Suggested approach: create an ephemeral quota override + add the CIDR to control-plane allowlist for that time window. set auto-revoke 2 hours after end. Need infra signoff.
ryan_eng: config snippet for control plane (canary-ready):
```json
{
  "customer": "saffron-31",
  "region": "europe-west3",
  "rate_limit": {
    "base_rps": 50,
    "temporary_window": {
      "start": "2025-05-14T10:00:00Z",
      "end": "2025-05-14T12:10:00Z",
      "override_rps": 250
    }
  },
  "allowlist": ["35.198.12.0/24"],
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```
marta_infra: that looks fine. two notes: 1) override_rps 250 -> acceptable but cap to 3x baseline is an infra policy; CI for dedicated pools may be required if sustained. 2) need to add a routing policy so traffic stays in europe region (no fallback to us).
devops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4529 — "SaffronAI EU demo: ephemeral QPS boost + allowlist". Assigned to infra-team. ETA for review: 4h.
tim_support: capturing a couple of operational gotchas from past demos: pre-warm KV cache for likely prefixes (we can send seed prompts), and set shorter timeout on retries for demo clients to avoid backlogs. I'll coordinate with Saffron for a quick pre-warm run 30m before start.
carla_csm: thanks — can someone confirm firewall add + quota override and post the exact window/IDs here when done? also labelling this as "renewal-risk-priority" so AE is in the loop. :eyes:
ryan_eng: infra-team approved pending a canary: I'll stand up a 5-min canary path at 09:40 UTC that routes a small % to the configured route, we'll monitor latency and token-cost.
marta_infra: firewall rule created: ALLOW-saffron-35-198-12, expires 2025-05-14T14:15:00Z. Quota override created: saffron-31-temp-eu-250rps (auto-revoke enabled). Added route policy europe-only.
nate_prodops: done from prod side: applied override id="OVR-8234" and set metric alarms (latency p95 > 450ms) to auto-rollback. tagging infra-monitor and oncall.
carla_csm: perfect. I'll run enablement with them on Tue 16:00 UTC and do the pre-warm at 09:30 on day-of. Also capturing feedback ask: Saffron wanted clearer docs on region pinning and per-route cost breakdown — can we follow up to add a short FAQ?
tim_support: noted, I'll draft an FAQ blurb and ping docs.
ryan_eng: monitoring hooks to watch: token throughput, GPU queue length, and prefix cache hit rate. I'll post dashboard link when available.
marta_infra: dashboard posted: https://console.redwood/internal/d/infra/saffron-demo (mock link). We'll watch and be ready to rollback at first sign of degradation.
carla_csm: huge thanks team. recap: allowlist + override in place, canary 09:40, pre-warm 09:30, demo 10:00-12:00 UTC, auto-revoke + rollback alarms set. I'll update the account record and let AE know. :thumbsup:
ryan_eng: adding one more ask from eng: capture exact token distribution from their pre-warm run so we can tune batching windows after demo.
carla_csm: copied. any objections to closing the ticket after the demo and a 24h health-check?
marta_infra: no objections. will leave auto-close = false so we can verify metrics.
devops-bot: Ticket CS-4529 status -> IN_PROGRESS. Comments appended.
carla_csm: great. moving to status: prepping.
